description.value: Cafe Club is a downtown Vancouver cafe on West Georgia Street built around an order-ahead model, letting customers skip the queue by ordering via the cafe's own mobile app or website before they arrive. The menu covers all-day breakfast and lunch — coffee, matcha lattes, juices, pastries, breakfast wraps, and salads — and the cafe also handles corporate and private event catering. Its location in Vancouver's business district makes it a convenient mid-ride fuel stop for cyclists moving through the city core.
